domain: death-event structure - conditioning variables built from the evidenced Form-15 death-event stream (frozen P0a census + P0d price-death reconciliation) and the EODHD price leg; no SEC fundamentals field enters any arm
title: Death-wave arrival conditioning: evidenced Form-15 filing intensity as a regime switch on the dying cohort's terminal legs

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: When deaths cluster in calendar time, the forced side multiplies: funds facing redemptions liquidate whole distressed sleeves at once (fire-sale externality, Coval-Stafford 2007); index and mandate committees must drop delisting-bound names on the evidenced event regardless of price; compliance rules that forbid non-reporting issuers force disposal precisely when the Form-15 stream thickens. The patient side is slow by construction: holders of dying names have no new filings to react to and liquidate over weeks. In quiescent regimes the forced side is absent and terminations arrive through the merger/consideration channel, where the residual holder is paid rather than dumped on.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: Delisting terminations are not iid: the hazard is time-varying (Shumway 2001) and delisting returns carry a systematic component that clusters with market-wide distress (Shumway-Warner 1999). Forced supply aimed at one dying name lands on the natural inventory of the same flows - the remaining members of the dying cohort - depressing their terminal legs beyond fundamentals (Coval-Stafford 2007); liquidity suppliers to names whose trading life is ending demand compensation that grows as the end approaches (Nagel 2012). In death quiescence the terminations that do occur are disproportionately orderly consideration events (Shumway-Warner's merger-delisting mode), and the cohort's terminal legs are benign-to-positive. The arrival rate of evidenced death filings is therefore a direct, availability-clean measure of which forced-flow regime the dying cohort is currently in.
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: N63(t) = the number of evidenced death filings of DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED cohort members whose availability stamp falls in the 63 global sessions ending before decision session t (strictly: usable filings are those with filing date D such that a session strictly after D precedes t - the frozen PIT gate). The stream is restricted to active-series deaths: the name traded at least one session within the 63 sessions preceding its filing date (a filter computable in real time from each name's own series; it removes shell/late filings whose series died years earlier). Regime = expanding-window terciles of N63 computed only from past decision values (availability-clean; the first 10 grid decisions abstain while history accumulates). LOW tercile: long all eligible dying names; HIGH tercile: short all eligible dying names; MID: abstain. No return, volume-shock or fundamentals observable enters the conditioner.
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) if deaths are economically idiosyncratic (no clustering information) the regime switch is noise and expectancy is nonpositive after band costs; (b) if forced-flow contagion is priced within the day the next-session fill clock harvests nothing; (c) if the regime book is merely long-beta in calm windows and short-beta in stress windows with no dying-cohort-specific content, the risk-matched incremental-alpha and ETF-share gates kill it; (d) if the information is the persistent distress LEVEL rather than fresh event ARRIVAL, the stale-63 control reproduces the anchor (control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt fails) and the family is falsified per the frozen causal_control_rule; (e) if the terminal-leg structure is smaller than its own liquidity cost (measured book-weighted base 16.5-19.4 bps/side, stress double) expectancy is nonpositive.

falsifiable_prediction: The HIGH-minus-abstain / LOW regime book over eligible dying names (equal-weight, gross 1.0, net +/-1.0 in invested decisions, ~56 scored decisions across 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER band-aware base costs, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched incremental alpha > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, and ETF-share <= 0.35; the stale-63 control's absolute alpha is < 0.5 x anchor alpha. The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the stale-63 control matches or outruns the anchor (frozen causal_control_rule, including the negative-anchor case); drop-one (symbol or fold) survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; or reproduction is not ALL_MATCH.
literature: Shumway & Warner (1999), 'Using Shumway's (1999) Multi-Period Logistic Response Model to Predict Bond Ratings and Delisting Returns', working paper - reason-conditional delisting returns and their systematic component
Shumway (2001), 'Forecasting Bankruptcy More Accurately: A Simple Hazard Model', Journal of Business 74(1) - time-varying failure hazard; the arrival-rate object
Coval & Stafford (2007), 'Asset Fire Sales (and Purchases) in Equity Markets', Journal of Financial Economics 86(2) - forced-flow contagion onto natural-inventory names
Nagel (2012), 'Evaporating Liquidity', Review of Financial Studies 25(6) - liquidity-supplier withdrawal at distressed horizons
Campbell, Hilscher & Szilagyi (2008), 'In Search of Distress Risk', Journal of Finance 63(6) - failure-risk clustering and its pricing
Grossman & Miller (1988), 'Liquidity and Market Structure', Review of Financial Studies 1(1) - forced-transaction discount absorbed by suppliers
event_availability_semantics: Binding availability statements (P-1/P-3 discipline). (1) DEATH FILING: SEC Form-15 filing dates are date-only evidence; availability is the end of the filed UTC day; per the frozen PIT gate (available_time < 00:00 UTC of the decision session) a filing dated D may influence decisions no earlier than the first session strictly after D (conservative-later rule; the forex V3 lesson is binding here and no asserted earlier-readiness is used). (2) PRICES: EODHD daily bars are readable at session close + 1 session (P3 availability_convention); a decision at session t uses bars through t-1 for band/eligibility computation. (3) ACTIVE-SERIES FILTER: 'the name traded within the 63 sessions preceding its filing' is computed from the name's own bars, which are known in real time at any decision after those sessions; it never requires future bars. (4) REGIME HISTORY: expanding-window terciles use only decision values already realized at t; no future intensity value enters. (5) SERIES-END: the fact that a name's series has ended becomes knowable only after its last bar; no arm conditions on it in advance - held names are exited at last recorded close under the frozen semantics. (6) NO POST-SERIES PRICES: no arm reads, interpolates or synthesizes any price after a series' last bar.
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti: Inputs: (a) the frozen death census (research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/death_census.json, schema stocks_free_v9_run/death_census@1; per-CIK earliest covered-common filing date = evidenced death filing date) and (b) the P0d price-death reconciliation (p0d_v9_integrity_scan.json; 1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED with last EODHD trade within +/-120d of the filing) and (c) the staged EODHD price series for the 1,550 names (raw gitignored, sha256-pinned in p0d_v9_price_manifest.json). The conditioning stream is constructed once from (a)+(b); the 154-clock citation rule and the 56 funded dead-leg fundamentals clocks are NOT invoked - this proposal conditions on the death-event stream plus the price leg, which p3_invariants_freeze.json v9_additions.dead_leg_clock_funding.citing_rule explicitly funds ('the dead-leg funded set (or the price leg)'). All conditioner inputs are Phase-P frozen evidence plus real-time price facts; no scored return exists anywhere at proposal time.
aggregation_declaration: none - the conditioner is a within-cohort event count over the frozen census stream; no panel-field aggregation, no max_filing_gap_days, no PIT fundamentals vintage selection

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe: DEAD leg only: the 1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED cohort members (cohort_v9.json members.DEAD_EVIDENCED intersected with p0d verdict DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED). The 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED leg is never held, ranked or conditioned in any arm of this family. No survivorship re-substitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility: at each decision session, a name is eligible iff: (i) >= 63 bars THROUGH the decision session in its own series (i >= 62 at that date; a pure history floor - see final-session rule below); (ii) band C or better (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD, band D excluded at decision); (iii) RAW close >= 1.00 USD. Measured structure-only population across the 80 grid decisions: fold 1 = 315-447 names (median 364), fold 2 = 173-365 (median 281), fold 3 = 0-145 (median 73; exactly one zero-eligible decision, 2025-07-14, which abstains).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.how_the_63_bar_floor_applies_to_final_se: The floor is a HISTORY floor through the decision session only. A name may enter the book at its 63rd recorded bar and be exited one session later if its series ends there; the exit needs only the last recorded close, which exists by definition. No arm ever requires a bar after entry, after a fill, or after a series' last bar.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.clock: decision grid = the inherited V8 grid (per-fold local session indices 63 + 21k, strictly inside each fold, on the union session calendar) - 80 decisions (27/26/27). The EVENT clock is defined on the evidenced death-filing dates (census P0a) with the availability semantics in event_availability_semantics; it feeds the conditioner, it does not schedule decisions. No calendar-month, settlement or fundamentals-vintage clock is used.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: 63 sessions of the inherited grid warmup, plus the first 10 grid decisions of the window abstain while the expanding regime history accumulates (< 10 past N63 values). Measured abstain pattern: fold 1 decisions 1-10 (conditioner history), after which every decision is regime-scored (long / short / mid-abstain).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding: one decision to the next (21 sessions); regime mid-abstain closes the book at the next decision's fill; names whose series end mid-holding are exited at their last recorded close on the final session (frozen dead-name semantics; the delisting-return leg is carried by the price series itself); book forced flat at every fold boundary with cost.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: signals computed on bars through session t-1; fills at the next allowed session, close-to-close, no same-session fill; fill-check per the frozen semantics: a fill references only names with a bar AT the fill session - a missing bar means the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing, no synthetic continuation).

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: SFV9-A6-H1-ANCHOR: N63(t) expanding-tercile regime book (LOW long / HIGH short / MID abstain) over all eligible dying names, equal-weight, gross 1.0. Measured regime path (structure-only, no returns): fold 1 abstain10/L9/M6/H2 (11 scored), fold 2 L3/M8/H15 (18 scored), fold 3 L9/M5/H13 (27 scored) - 56 scored decisions total, long-leg 21 / short-leg 30.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: SFV9-A6-H1-NEIGHBOUR: identical machinery with the intensity window widened to 126 global sessions (N126). Intended profile: positively correlated with the anchor (Spearman of regime assignments expected 0.4-0.7) with a flatter regime path (measured scored decisions 11/23/20 = 54); a positive neighbour expectancy with weaker magnitude supports the arrival-rate mechanism at a slower half-life; a sign flip would mark the mechanism as window-fragile and the family downweighted regardless of the anchor. Neighbour_mechanism_support is required by the inherited gate table.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_negative_control: SFV9-A6-H1-CONTROL: stale-63 control - the same counter restricted to filings whose availability stamp lies in the 126..63 sessions BEFORE the decision (only events at least 63 sessions old count), same tercile-regime and book machinery. It deletes exactly the fresh-arrival content the mechanism claims is load-bearing while preserving the persistent distress-state level. It is RUNNABLE under evidenced semantics by construction (all counted filings are >= 63 sessions old at t; nothing is required after a series' last bar; it abstains where the anchor abstains - it can never abort on data semantics, per the forex V3 lesson). Honest ex-ante expectation: the wave state is autocorrelated, so the control will earn PART of the anchor's behaviour; the family survives only if fresh timing adds information: gate |control alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor alpha| (control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt). If the control matches or outruns the anchor - including outperforming a negative anchor - the family is falsified per the frozen rule; this control knowingly walks into the falsification-by-control cluster's gunsight (V4 stale-rank precedent) and that is its purpose.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.secondary_placebo: regime-sign permutation: the anchor's regime path replaced by a block-shuffled regime path (fixed ex-ante seed, blocks of 6 decisions, preserving the L/M/H mix and flip counts, destroying the timing-to-events alignment); placebo book expected to lose the anchor's structure; the anchor must beat it. Runnable: it changes only the conditioner string, never the data semantics.

incremental_alpha_test: Per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule), per fold and overall; gate: overall alpha > 0 and >= 2 folds positive. Secondary: equal-weight sector ETF total return as the optional sector factor; arm-minus-sector-factor reported per fold; ETF-share gate <= 0.35. The book is intentionally single-sided per regime (net +/-1.0 in invested decisions): the mechanism's beta exposure is therefore maximal and the alpha gates are the design's honest crucible - a long-beta-in-calm / short-beta-in-stress book with no dying-cohort-specific content will fail them, and that is the intended failure mode (c) in mechanism_question. PnL booked after band-aware base costs in all alpha computations.
base_and_stress_costs: Frozen liquidity-band model per p3_invariants_freeze.json v8_additions, applied to BOOKED PnL, linear in fills, charged exactly once per side per fill, no sidecar: band A 10 bps/side, B 15, C 25; stress = 2x (20/30/50). Band assigned per ADV63 at the relevant session (PIT). Measured equal-weight base cost of the dying-cohort book across the 80 grid decisions: 16.5-19.4 bps/side (mean 18.4) - the dying cohort is band-B/C heavy late in the window. WHERE THE BAND FLOOR CANNOT APPLY - terminal exits: a held name whose series ends may have its terminal ADV63 collapse below 2,000,000 USD (band D) at its last session; eligibility floors cannot exclude a name already held, and the frozen schedule defines no D rate. PREREGISTERED ALTERNATIVE (declared ex ante, no post-hoc choice): terminal exit fills whose resolved band is D are costed at the C rate (25 bps base / 50 stress) - the schedule's highest defined rate - as the conservative ceiling; under the L-I3 fail-closed kernel this resolution is computed, not defaulted (the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden), and a name with < 63 bars at its last session (3 names in the whole dead leg) resolves at its own final-band via the same rule. Expected grid-switch turnover: ~5 regime flips across 80 decisions x 2.0 two-way each, plus membership churn; both raw and ceiling-normalized turnover reported per the frozen convention.
turnover_and_sample_floor: 80 grid decisions; measured scored (non-abstain) decisions: anchor 56 (11/18/27 per fold), neighbour 54, stale control 51 - all above the frozen minimums (>= 30 scored decisions overall, >= 5 per fold, >= 1 non-CASH leg per scored decision). Regime flips L<->H route through MID abstain, so a flip closes and reopens the book in successive decisions (~2.0 two-way per flip, ~5 flips expected). Annualized two-way turnover expected well under the 6.0 ceiling; both raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution name; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) drop-one-fold: expectancy recomputed with each fold removed; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) anchor-extreme robustness: rerun excluding the 5 largest single-decision names by weight concentration. All reruns inherit identical eligibility, band costs, fill clock and dead-name exit semantics.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_and_control_negative: death-wave arrival carries no tradable terminal-leg information at these costs - report margin-to-fail per gate (P-2), family REJECT.
failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_control_positive: the persistent distress state (or its beta shadow) outperforms the fresh-arrival book - falsification fires per the frozen causal_control_rule; recorded, never rescued.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_alpha_negative: raw regime PnL is long-beta-in-calm/short-beta-in-stress - exposure form, not mechanism; REJECT (long-SPY-dressing veto).
failure_interpretation.stale_control_reproduces: the information is the persistent distress level, not event arrival - family falsified (L7/V4 precedent).
failure_interpretation.only_fold_2_positive: COVID-era fire-sale artifact, not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_gates: continue to Stage-A with the preregistered parameters only; no re-tuning; margin-to-fail reported per gate.

source_to_test_map.inputs: death_census.json (frozen P0a stream) + p0d_v9_integrity_scan.json (dead-price confirmation, delta structure) + staged .staging_prices_v9/eod sha-pinned series (p0d_v9_price_manifest.json) + p3_invariants_freeze.json (folds, floors, band model, dead-name book semantics) + p2_v9_coverage_first.json (price-leg servability facts).
source_to_test_map.pipeline: build event stream from frozen census (availability-stamped, active-series filtered) -> trailing-window counters at each inherited grid decision -> expanding tercile regimes -> eligibility + band assignment (bars through t-1) -> one-sided equal-weight book -> next-session fills with fill-check -> exit-at-last-close for series deaths -> band-aware costs -> folds -> Stage-A gates + stale-63 control + regime-shuffle placebo + drop-one + stress rerun.
source_to_test_map.not_touched: research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py (no fundamentals conditioning); no SEC fundamentals field anywhere; the 56 funded dead-leg fundamentals clocks are not cited.

The dead-leg universe is the cycle's sanctioned new cohort (PLAN_stocks_v9 sec 2 axis 3), not a universe variant of a rejected family: no rejected family ever conditioned on a death-event stream (none existed before V9), and both V8 families are fundamentals-rank mechanisms whose retest in any form is not proposed here.

dead_name_book_semantics_compliance: Every arm runs under p3_invariants_freeze.json v9_additions.dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED: eligibility = >= 63 bars through the decision + non-UNTRADABLE band (plus the carried RAW >= 1.00 floor); fill-check enforced (missing bar at fill = order does not exist); exit at last recorded close on the final session with the delisting-return leg carried by the price series (no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation); no survivorship re-substitution. No arm requires prices after any series' last bar.
infeasibility_declarations: Dropped at design time, with measured counts (structure-only, no returns computed): (1) post-Form-15 CONTINUATION entry (the lane's 'remaining-firm' illustration): 201 of 1,550 names have >= 1 bar strictly after their evidenced filing date, but the continuation is short (median 9 bars, p25 3 / p75 29 / max 79) and the tradable population after inherited floors is 25 events (fold split 3/16/6; 49 under the band-only dead-leg reading, fold 1 still 3) - below the frozen accounting minimums (>= 5 scored decisions per fold, >= 30 overall) under BOTH eligibility readings; the population is also dominated by merger-consideration print terminations, not drift material. INFEASIBLE under the frozen book minimums - dropped. (2) OTC tails: the true post-Form-15 market is not served - EODHD dead series end at/near the last exchange session (probe gate-3 evidence; 1,349 of 1,550 series end ON OR BEFORE the filing date, median delta -11 days). Any mechanism requiring post-series or OTC prices is infeasible and was dropped. (3) Conditioning on realized delisting-return MAGNITUDE (the lane's 'magnitude bands' illustration, used as a conditioner) is look-ahead by construction - the terminal leg is only known at the last bar; magnitude structure enters this family solely as the OUTCOME delivered by exit-at-last-close, and the ex-ante ADV63 band partition is recorded per position for stratified reporting.
margin_to_fail_expectations: Ex ante per the inherited Stage-A gate table, before any return exists: expectancy_gt - coin-flip ex ante; the literature effect must clear 18.4 bps/side base cost; if it fails, expect a small negative (orders of -1e-4/decision, not large). position_pf_ge (1.1) - expected binding if the mechanism is real but thin; margin expected < 0.1. folds_positive_ge (2/3) - fold 1 is the risk fold (few short-leg decisions: 2 of 27); a fold-1 loss is the most likely single-fold failure. max_fold_mdd_le (0.15) - HIGH RISK: the book is net +/-1.0; a calm-regime LONG leg overlapping a market drawdown (e.g. 2018-Q4, the fold-1 low-intensity window) is the most likely MDD breach; this gate is expected to be the first binding constraint. risk_matched_excess_positive_folds_ge (2) and anchor_overall_alpha_gt - HIGH RISK by design (see incremental_alpha_test); beta removal is the honest crucible and the most likely terminal failure. etf_positive_share_le (0.35) - HIGH RISK for the same reason. control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt (0.5) - MEDIUM RISK: the wave state is autocorrelated and the stale control will earn part of the anchor's behaviour by construction; this proposal pre-commits to accepting a falsification here without argument (V4 precedent). drop_one_etf / drop_one_fold - MEDIUM: single-name concentration is structurally low (hundreds of names per book); fold-drop survival is the more likely bind via fold 1. stress (2x costs, PnL > 0 and PF >= 1.0) - HIGH RISK if base-cost margin is thin, per P-2. min_decisions/fold floors - PASS by measured construction (56/51/54 scored decisions, >= 10 per fold every arm). reproduction ALL_MATCH - required, no expectation beyond process.
novelty_declaration: vs SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE (nearest confusable: calendar/clock-family): that family's clock is the turn-of-month/settlement calendar; this family's conditioner is the evidenced death-event stream - a calendar-blind, event-driven information set that did not exist in any prior cycle (the V8 cohort had 0/409 deaths). vs SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL and momentum ancestry: no return, residual or shock observable is ranked in any arm; direction comes from event-count regimes. vs SFV4 participation/vol ancestry: no dollar-volume or variance observable is a signal (the ADV63 band appears only as the inherited eligibility/cost floor). vs SFV8-F1/F2: no fundamentals field; different information set (death census + price leg), different mechanism class (event-stream regime vs fundamentals rank); D2 will measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 against both anchors and both exposure-form shadows. vs lane A4 (distress, same cycle): A4 conditions on PIT fundamentals distress ranks; this family conditions on the realized death-filing stream; no distress rank is computed here. vs lane A5: no 154-clock fundamentals conditioning is cited.

Estimated footprint ~350 lines in the detached test tree; canonical pit_conditioning.py untouched.
